title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: tidy interface VAR models fitted vars. tidyvars makes results Vector Autoregressive (VAR) models easier inspect, manipulate visualize. package replace vars reimplement VAR econometrics. vars performs statistical calculations; tidyvars organizes results consistent tidy objects work naturally dplyr, tidyr, ggplot2.

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: Model estimation stays exactly belongs: vars. point , tidyvars provides consistent interface working fitted model.

title: Extends broom for VAR models

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: Impulse response functions forecast error variance decompositions follow pattern. impulse response can inspected directly data: row identifies horizon, impulse, response, estimate, confidence interval. object can plotted directly:  FEVD results also returned tidy form, one contribution horizon, response, shock:  Conceptually: objects can filtered, transformed, joined, plotted using standard tidyverse tools.

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: tidyvars provides autoplot() methods IRFs, FEVDs, forecasts. plotting methods define structure visualization impose visual identity package. tidyvars plot still regular ggplot object: optional visual system separates layout colour: theme_tidyvars() controls structural elements typography, spacing, grids, facets, legends without changing colours used data. palette_tidyvars() applies package colour identity explicitly requested. Discrete scales also available independently ordinary ggplot2 graphics: keeps visual system optional fully compatible normal ggplot2 customization.
code: autoplot(irf) +   ggplot2::theme_classic() autoplot(irf) +   theme_tidyvars() +   palette_tidyvars() theme_tidyvars()   → layout and typography palette_tidyvars() → colours scale_color_tidyvars() scale_fill_tidyvars()
